Game Overview

In Bullet and Cry in Space, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a chilling spaceship where danger lurks in every shadow. Experience intense action as you fight grotesque creatures with immersive visuals and eerie sounds. Unravel the ship's secrets, survive with strategy and precision, and power up to face the lurking unknown. Can you survive the darkness?
